name: dakyworld-os
description: Convenience wrapper. The real build lives in server/, which also builds server/client — see the note in railway.json.

scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix server/client audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.security: npm run scan:secrets && npm run audit
scripts.site: npm run seo && npm run breadcrumbs && npm run links
